description_en: Creates an account group. The management account or a delegated administrator account in a resource directory can create account groups to centrally manage resources, compliance packages, and rules for multiple members
description_zh: 资源目录中的管理账号或委派管理员账号可以创建账号组，在账号组中集中地管理多个成员的资源、合规包和规则
name: CreateAggregator

parameters.help_en: The name of the account group
parameters.name: aggregator_name

parameters.example: Example aggregator used to demonstrate how to create an aggregator.
parameters.help_en: The description of the account group
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
The ID of the member account.
For information about how to obtain the member account ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
fields.help_zh:
成员ID。
关于如何获取成员ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
fields.name: account_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the member account.
For information about how to obtain the member account name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
fields.help_zh:
成员名称。
关于如何获取成员名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html

fields.help_en: The affiliation of the member account. Only `ResourceDirectory` (resource directory) is supported
fields.help_zh: 成员归属。仅支持`ResourceDirectory`（资源目录）
fields.name: account_type

parameters.help_en:
All member accounts in the account group.

If `AggregatorType` is set to `RD`, this parameter can be left empty, which indicates that all members in the resource directory are added to the global account group.
If `AggregatorType` is set to `FOLDER`, this parameter can be left empty, which indicates that all members in a specific folder of the resource directory are added to the folder-based account group
parameters.help_zh:
账号组内的所有成员账号。

当`AggregatorType`为`RD时，该参数可以为空，表示将资源目录中的所有成员添加至全局账号组。
当`AggregatorType`为`FOLDER`时，该参数可以为空，表示将资源目录中某个资源夹中的所有成员添加至资源夹账号组
parameters.name: aggregator_accounts

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the account group. Valid values:
RD: global account group.
FOLDER: folder-based account group. You must also specify FolderId. For information about how to obtain the folder ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html.
CUSTOM (default): custom account group. You must also specify AccountId and AccountType in AggregatorAccounts
parameters.help_zh:
账号组类型。取值：
RD：全局账号组。
FOLDER：资源夹账号组。必须同时设置`FolderId`。关于如何获取资源夹ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html。
CUSTOM（默认值）：自定义账号组。必须同时设置`AggregatorAccounts`中的`AccountId`和`AccountType`
parameters.name: aggregator_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the folder to bind. Multiple folder IDs are supported. Separate multiple folder IDs with commas (,).

This parameter is required if AggregatorType is set to `FOLDER`
parameters.help_zh:
绑定的资源夹ID。支持多值，多个资源夹ID之间用半角逗号(,)分隔

当`AggregatorType`为`FOLDER`时，必须设置本参数
parameters.name: folder_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
